title: Energy Division Tariff Schedule E-1 — Tank Ownership and Tank Service Charges
content:
Schedule E-1 fixes, for each programme carried under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts, who ordinarily owns the tank at the member's site, what the cooperative charges to rent, set, pull and move it, how often the tank and regulator are inspected, and whether a leak check is required before a tank that has run out is refilled. The figures in the schedule are the catalogue figures for the programme; nothing on a ticket or a statement varies them.

## Schedule of tank charges by programme

| Programme | Tank ordinarily owned by | Annual tank rent, USD | Gallons bought in a year at or above which rent is waived | Tank set fee, USD | Tank removal fee, USD | Tank relocation fee, USD | Inspection interval, years | Leak check required before refill after a run-out |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | the cooperative | 95.00 | 500 | 175.00 | 175.00 | 225.00 | 5 | required |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | the cooperative | 0.00 | 400 | 0.00 | 175.00 | 225.00 | 5 | required |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | the cooperative | 0.00 | 400 | 0.00 | 175.00 | 225.00 | 5 | required |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | the cooperative | 0.00 | 400 | 0.00 | 175.00 | 225.00 | 5 | required |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | the member | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3 | not required |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | the cooperative | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3 | not required |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Annual tank rent is carried only on the Will-Call Propane Account, at 95.00 USD; every other programme in the schedule carries the rent at nil.
2. The waiver gallons column is the yearly purchase figure at or above which the rent for the year is waived. It stands at 500 gallons on the Will-Call Propane Account and at 400 gallons on the Keep-Full Automatic Delivery, Budget Payment Plan and Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Accounts. The Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery and Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Accounts carry no rent and no waiver figure.
3. A tank set is charged at 175.00 USD on the Will-Call Propane Account alone. Removal stands at 175.00 USD and relocation at 225.00 USD on the four cooperative-owned propane programmes, and at nil on the two programmes whose sites carry no cooperative tank charge.
4. The inspection interval is 5 years on the four propane programmes and 3 years on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery and Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Accounts.
